extracted.name: Reindeer Munch
extracted.description: Kids young and old will love this reindeer munch, made with rice cereal squares, pretzel sticks, peanuts, and candy-coated milk chocolate pieces, then drizzled with a white chocolate topping.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups crispy rice cereal squares (such as Rice Chex®)
1 cup candy-coated milk chocolate pieces (such as M&M's®)
1 (12 ounce) package white vanilla baking chips
instruction_lines: Stir cereal squares, pretzel sticks, peanuts, and milk chocolate pieces together in a large bowl.

Melt the vanilla baking chips in a microwave-safe glass or ceramic bowl in 30-second intervals, stirring after each melting, for 1 to 3 minutes (depending on your microwave). Drizzle melted chips over cereal mixture. Pour mixture out onto a large piece of aluminum foil and cool for 30 minutes. Break into bite-size pieces.
